name: עַמְרָם
summary: Above all Amram son of Kohath, of Levi, who married Jochebed and was the father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam; he lived 137 years (Exo 6:18, 20; Num 26:58–59; 1Ch 5:28–29), and his descendants, the Amramites, kept the treasuries of the house of God (Num 3:27; 1Ch 26:23). Also a son of Bani who had taken a foreign wife in Ezra's day (Ezr 10:34). The name is עַם “people, kinsman” with רָם “high, exalted”, like עַמִּינָדָב and עַמִּיהוּד: “the kinsman is exalted”, or “the people is exalted”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of Kohath: עַמְרָם and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.”
“Amram took Jochebed … and she bore him Aaron and Moses; and the years of the life of Amram were 137.”
The family of the Amramites, of the Kohathites.
Moses' parents, by faith, hid him three months.
“וְרָם הוּא above all the peoples”: the second element.

note: BDB's p.dp.ac (14 tokens). The first element may be עַם “people” or the older sense “paternal kinsman” (as in Gen 25:8 “gathered to his people”); which is meant is not shown. The gentilic עַמְרָמִי is not claimed. 1Ch 1:41 חַמְרָן (KJV “Amram”) is a different name.
